"""Pin actual accepted inputs and describe remaining receipts without inventing results."""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from common import (
    AUDIT,
    INTEGRATION,
    ORIGINAL_SCIENCE,
    PACKAGE,
    ROOT,
    SCIENCE,
    TARGET_SHA,
    bind,
    now,
    read,
    sha,
    verify,
    write,
)

pinned = [
    INTEGRATION / "handoff.json",
    INTEGRATION / "artifact-manifest.json",
    INTEGRATION / "common.py",
    INTEGRATION / "accepted-inputs.json",
    INTEGRATION / "expected-changes.json",
    INTEGRATION / "dossier-plan.json",
    SCIENCE / "handoff.json",
    SCIENCE / "artifact-manifest.json",
    SCIENCE / "review.json",
    ORIGINAL_SCIENCE / "review.json",
    ORIGINAL_SCIENCE / "edge-assessments.json",
    AUDIT / "handoff.json",
    AUDIT / "artifact-manifest.json",
    AUDIT / "review.json",
    Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-root-canonical-review-intake-20261012.json"),
    Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-root-integration-helper-review-20261012.json"),
]
assert (
    sha(SCIENCE / "handoff.json")
    == "3d4f6b2ef059634855aec931f20c85bbfcc36655aa482357ab74c0cb1971b884"
)
assert (
    sha(AUDIT / "handoff.json")
    == "bb93020710815a17cfd1090407359937a8e2366883896a3a6da72d6f4c9884f0"
)
assert sha(pinned[-2]) == "d31b3fccb4b85deec6eceec991397da5d681584c1bb4ddc6471217310c200061"
verified = {}
for directory in [SCIENCE, AUDIT]:
    manifest = read(directory / "artifact-manifest.json")
    for row in manifest["artifacts"]:
        verify({**row, "path": str(directory / row["path"])})
    verified[str(directory)] = len(manifest["artifacts"])
write(
    PACKAGE / "accepted-bindings.json",
    {
        "at": now(),
        "target_sha256": TARGET_SHA,
        "files": [bind(p) for p in pinned],
        "fresh_verified_review_artifacts": verified,
        "whole_implementation_and_canonical_build_reverification": (
            "Root and integration packet retain full exact verificati"
            "on. This preparer freshly rehashes both accepted indepen"
            "dent review packets and pins their immutable source bind"
            "ings."
        ),
    },
)
write(
    PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json",
    {
        "at": now(),
        "role": "packaging preparer and original author",
        "maintained_root": str(ROOT),
        "actual_adoption": bind(Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-adoption-20261012.json")),
        "actual_tested_inputs": bind(
            Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-tested-input-bindings-20261012.json")
        ),
        "tested_input_count": len(
            read("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-tested-input-bindings-20261012.json")["files"]
        ),
        "current_gate_success_claim": False,
        "current_saved_review_claim": False,
        "current_history_claim": False,
        "maintained_writes": False,
        "required_later_receipts": [
            "all eight completed maintained gate commands and complete logs",
            "successful exact preservation with any display changes explicitly source-assessed",
            "actual page/graph/anchor QA and real static image observation",
            "root assessment binding those receipts and stating actual limitations",
            "native inspect/validate/save/check and native history scaffold/validation",
            "final exact file bindings and post-finalization preservation",
        ],
        "diagnostic_attempt": "A broader-than-needed ignored/hidden/followed /private/t"
        "mp filename search was interrupted after unrelated dangl"
        "ing-link errors; no absence conclusion uses it. Actual r"
        "equired paths were then resolved directly from sealed ac"
        "cepted-inputs.json.",
    },
)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "status": "prepared_actual_acceptance_pins",
            "review_artifacts_verified": verified,
            "maintained_writes": False,
        },
        indent=2,
    )
)
